item.title: Cherish the BlueKing You Encounter
item.description: 1. My Experience Building Platforms After graduation I joined Tencent BlueKing, mainly working on SaaS development. After nearly three years there, I went back to my hometown of Wuhan and joined QingCloud, where I was responsible for DevOps R&D. After nearly two years, I joined a new company, took part in building a business support platform, and thought about how the business side puts Kubernetes into practice.
